findings.reason: the plan should name pulse_writer.py as the owner of the layout and require §4 to read through that owner, migrating `_read_pulse_ids` to it, or the "change in one place" claim in §4 is false.
findings.text: the writer's output layout (one `{ids}.nc` per IDS under `<root>/<shot>/`) is known at packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/pulse_writer.py:307 and :335 (writer), and at scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:34 and :37 (`PULSE_DIR`, `_read_pulse_ids`, whose own docstring calls itself the one place it is known); §4 (scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:45 `_read_ids`, :53 `_open_phase`, which today read the description store, not a minted pulse) would make it three, and jt60sa-facility-mint §8 is about to change it to one flat run file per pulse

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the join stays behind write_pulse and the animation adds a mode to one existing driver rather than a family of shallow wrappers; no section spreads one behaviour across several modules.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's stated goal of one site. The writer's output layout already has two knowers and the plan adds a third without naming the owner to extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 adds a path-rule accessor (pulse_writer.py exposes none today) and widens write_pulse's output contract without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §2's ambix citations are all accurate and present (latent/topology.read_topology, camera_topology_targets._strike_points, equilibrium_labels.xpoint_null_set, `_axis_and_boundary`), but the §4 reuse map names scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py only as a time-trace drawer and misses that it already owns a reader of the writer's output.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §4 extends scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py rather than adding a parallel script, and states why (the animation needs that driver's geometry, and imas-ink owns rendering); §2 extends pulse_writer.py rather than restating the layout.
